Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 3 by incorrectly concluding that a 2007 release of "Kingdom of Rock" existed. This conclusion was based on a hallucination or misinterpretation of the search results, which only showed a general "List of 2007 albums" page and a "Kingdom of Rock" entry for a 2008 release (Graham Elks) on AllMusic. The Planner falsely asserted that a 2007 entry was found and used this unverified date to claim that "Kingdom of Rock" (2007) predates "Was I The Wave?" (2011). This premature and factually incorrect assumption led to a flawed comparison and an incorrect final answer, as the actual earliest confirmed release for "Kingdom of Rock" (Magnus Karlsson's Free Fall) was 2015, which is later than 2011.
